name: zdeclient_fill_feature_entries
description: zDEClient::FillFeatureEntries fills a destination range with repeated copies of one feature-entry record.
known_limits: The original helper is VC-era vector support code using raw 13-dword record copies and thiscall/stdcall-like cleanup shape. tier S is deferred to the zDEClient vector/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x458a70 validates count-guarded repeated 13-dword copies from the source feature-entry record to the destination range, advancing the destination by 52 bytes for each count.
The native helper smoke verifies filling a destination entry from a source feature entry and the null-destination one-count no-store path.
